description.p: Streak is a habit tracker that respects you. Create as many habits as you like, log them with a single click, and follow your progress through an activity grid, streak counters and a statistics dashboard. It is fast, offline, and built to feel calm rather than demanding.
No accounts, no subscriptions, no ads, no tracking. Every habit and setting stays on your computer, and the full source is open.

ul.li: Three kinds of habit: normal, avoid with relapses, and amount with your own unit and goal
Flexible schedules: daily, a few times a week or month, chosen weekdays, or every few days
Checklists, day notes with photos, vacation mode and rest days
A focus timer with Pomodoro rounds, calm scenes and built-in sounds
Activity grid by week, month or year, streak history and habit strength
To-dos and notes beside your habits
Three styles, light and dark themes and your own accent colour
Import from Loop Habit Tracker, HabitKit, Habitica, HabitBull or a CSV file
Backups as a single file, automatic backups and a PIN lock
